name: Boku Kano 3 ~ Otoko no Ko o Suki ni Naru Jun'ai Triangle + 1
original_name: ボクカノ3 ～男の娘を好きになる純愛トライアングル+1
source:
Tadakatsu Fusamoto was lazy during all his campus life, and now struggling to find a job.
He is sent to his old school for the teaching practice, and find Minami and Narumi, his twin little brothers, who push him around using their cuteness!
Then one day, he met a school girl in the school gym at night. He immediately fell in love with her, not knowing her true identity...

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE073220.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
总元忠胜在整个校园生活中都很懒散，如今正为找工作苦恼。
他被派回母校进行教育实习，发现双胞胎弟弟总元珠波和总元成海正凭可爱模样使唤他！
后来有一天，他在夜晚的学校体育馆遇见一名女学生，立刻坠入爱河，却不知道她的真实身份……
